fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 901 Castle Rd, Secaucus NJ - CJ Logistics America NJ Secaucus Center. CJ open-space spec sheet: 107,929 SF warehouse, 188,615 SF total property (~4.33 acres), 19 exterior docks, 19 trailer positions, 4 drive-in doors, 20 ft clear height.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The property is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence (visible in 2019 and 2024 Street View). The truck driveway off Castle Rd passes through a fence gate opening - a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear guard booth visible at the driveway in Street View; a small structure sits at the SW corner of the yard but is not positioned as a gate booth. Classified guardShack false / remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: CJ spec sheet states 19 exterior docks - matches the 10-25 band. Docks on the SW and SE faces of the building.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Geofence box (~8.2 acres) captures the full building footprint plus the south truck yard. CJ's cited parcel is ~4.33 acres - the dark-roofed building appears to be multi-tenant and larger than CJ's 107,929 SF lease; site-area figure is therefore approximate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: South truck yard holds parked trailers and tractors - functions as a drop yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach from Castle Rd into a tight infill yard - minimal stacking depth.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Secaucus / NJ Meadowlands - extremely dense urban industrial area.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs nearby (Meadowlands corridor) but no spur into this property.

citations.claim: CJ Logistics own open-space sales sheet names 901 Castle Road, Secaucus NJ as a CJ Logistics America building (107,929 SF)

verification.rationale: CJ own marketing page lists 901 Castle Rd Secaucus as an active CJ-held building; no negative found.
